args.sql_query:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        product_id,
        product_name,
        price_diff_from_category_max AS price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price_diff_from_category_max DESC) AS price_rank
    FROM gold_category_highest_priced_product
)
SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    price,
    price_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE price_rank = 1
ORDER BY price DESC

SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    price_diff_from_category_max AS price,
    MAX(price_diff_from_category_max) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS category_max_price,
    ROUND(
        (price_diff_from_category_max / MAX(price_diff_from_category_max) OVER (PARTITION BY category)) * 100,
        1
    ) AS pct_of_category_max,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS products_in_category
FROM gold_category_highest_priced_product
ORDER BY category, price_diff_from_category_max DESC
